assumptions: 30-yr fixed rate 6.621% (Zillow Home Loans rate shown on the listing, snapshot 2024-06-05).
20% down ($59,980); loan $239,920; principal and interest only; no PMI at 20% down.
Property tax = 1.60% x asking price / 12. Actual tax uses the appraised value, and rates change yearly.
unknowns: HOA fee not disclosed in the listing (absence does not mean $0).
Homeowners insurance: no quote (Zillow shows an unverified estimate of $1,260/yr, not included).
Flood insurance: depends on FEMA zone and elevation, check before buying in Houston.
MUD/PID district taxes may not be included in the listed tax rate.
Utilities, maintenance and closing costs are not included.

sources.name: Fair-price range
sources.detail: LightGBM quantile models (q10/q50/q90), 5-fold spatial block CV, cross-fold conformal calibration; out-of-fold coverage 0.7998 (target 0.80)

sources.name: Price receipt
sources.detail: Geographically weighted regression (k=200, computed in q/kdb+); items sum to the fair price

sources.name: Comparable homes
sources.detail: Nearest listings in the same snapshot (asking prices, not sales)

sources.name: Mortgage rate
sources.detail: Zillow Home Loans 30-yr fixed rate embedded in the listing

limitations: Asking prices only; no closed-sale prices. 'Fair' means consistent with comparable listings.
One snapshot (June 2024); no market trend adjustment.
The 80% range is calibrated per home type across Houston; individual neighborhoods may be covered more or less often.
Verification signals are evidence for a human to check, not a fraud score.
No inspection, title, flood-zone, or permit data.
